insurer_name: Bajaj Allianz General Insurance Company Limited

maternity_coverage.limit_text: Rs 15,000 normal / Rs 25,000 C-section for SI 3-7.5L; Rs 25,000 normal / Rs 35,000 C-section for SI 10-50L. Max 2 deliveries lifetime. 72-month waiting period.
maternity_coverage.notes: Includes pre/post natal hospitalization. Ectopic pregnancy under in-patient cover.

newborn_coverage.limit_text: Covered up to 90 days from birth within maternity sum insured. Mandatory vaccinations included.

ayush_coverage.limit_text: Up to Rs 20,000 per policy year for in-patient Ayurvedic/Homeopathic treatment in government or QCI/NABH accredited institutes.

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Up to Rs 20,000 per policy year for road ambulance to nearest emergency hospital or transfer to higher-facility hospital.

organ_donor_expenses.notes: Donor harvesting expenses payable subject to compliance with Transplantation of Human Organs Act and accepted in-patient claim.

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: At end of every 3-year block: reimburse 1% of SI up to Rs 5,000 per member (individual) or proposer+spouse (floater).

restoration_benefit.limit_text: 100% reinstatement of base SI once per policy year after exhaustion. Not available for relapse within 45 days.
restoration_benefit.notes: Once-in-lifetime for cancer of specified severity and end-stage renal disease.

day_care_treatments.limit_text: Day care procedures per annexure I covered as inpatient treatment.

room_rent_capping: No sub-limit on room/boarding/nursing or ICU.
icu_capping: No cap; actual ICU expenses paid.
